lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots starting posterior to the gill slits, forming a semi-regular geometric grid pattern across the mid-section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of high pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows, creating a grid where spots frequently align with the vertical-horizontal intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge extends along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with a light-facing dorsal edge and a shadowed ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains approximately 6-10 visible high-luminance blobs of varying sizes distributed across its lateral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A visible notch or irregular growth is present on the trailing (posterior) edge of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The head region displays a significantly higher density of smaller, more concentrated high-luminance spots compared to the rest of the body patterning.
